title: New Atlantis
author: Francis Bacon
description: "New Atlantis" by Francis Bacon is a utopian novel published posthumously in 1626.
longDescription: A European crew loses their way in the Pacific and discovers Bensalem, a mythical island where Christian piety meets scientific ambition.

authorInfo.bio: Francis Bacon (1561–1626) wrote New Atlantis. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
